verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question for an AI inference and fine-tuning platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack says customer data is excluded from model training, nor does it document a zero-retention or training opt-out control. The US-only serverless and data-residency items cover where data is processed, not whether it is used for training, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
